GREEN.title: Good Air Quality
GREEN.advice: Air quality is satisfactory and poses little or no health risk. Safe for all outdoor activities and exercise.

YELLOW.title: Moderate Air Quality
YELLOW.advice: Air quality is acceptable; however, unusually sensitive individuals should consider limiting prolonged outdoor exertion.

ORANGE.title: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups
ORANGE.advice: Members of sensitive groups (children, elderly, asthma/heart patients) may experience health effects and should avoid strenuous outdoor activity.

RED.title: Hazardous Air Quality
RED.advice: Health alert: serious risk for the entire population. Avoid outdoor exertion, keep windows closed, and use N95 masks.

COMPOUND.title: Dual Convergence Outbreak
COMPOUND.advice: Critical public health warning: severe pollution coincides with a verified spike in citizen respiratory illness. Seek prompt medical care if breathless.

STALE.title: Telemetry Updating
STALE.advice: Station telemetry is temporarily updating or offline. Exercise routine precautionary measures until fresh readings arrive.
